review: Heishou Pack You branch Sinclair is a Rupture Burn hybrid ID that has quite an interesting role due to his specifics in the kit. Bear in mind that this ID is very restrictive in team building. It also requires E.G.O. usage for additional Rupture Count generation, though not necessary in good team builds. He is very Count negative, and the trade-off to this is to yield huge amounts of damage through multiple Coins and his various passives. Let’s start to break his kit down through his passives, the First Passive, “Gamefowl, gives the ID “Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu” Exalted Command interaction, which when it targets Sinclair gives Hong Lu the following effect: “When using a Skill to inflict Rupture Potency or Count, inflict 1 Burn (3 times per turn.)
